title: feat(console): phone app menu bar with pinned entries, and a starred full menu behind More
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBC1PnQMdzhBbghvsdFDYrBV)_
Fixes #34594
Clause-②: yes (widening — one @object-ui/layout export + new @object-ui/i18n locale keys; no metadata key)
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzimyx6JQRaukBK3z17 (card thread for #34594, claim 6937381288)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：手机宽度（768 px 以下）进入应用后，列表、仪表盘、报表、页面底部常驻一条菜单栏：前 4 格是用户在本应用固定（星标）的菜单项，按用户的固定顺序，不足 4 个时用菜单前几项补齐；最后一格「更多」打开完整菜单（保留分组、可搜索、每项带星标，点星即固定/取消，底部栏随即变化）。左上角在手机上改为「返回首页」（环境首页）。记录详情页、新建表单、编辑表单不显示菜单栏。
- 为什么改：维护者原话「手机端点开进入应用之后，菜单在左侧，会不会很多人不知道」：以前菜单只在左上角一个无文字图标后的抽屉里。
- 风险与回滚：只动控制台前端（`@object-ui/app-shell` 布局、`@object-ui/layout` 新增一个公开函数、`@object-ui/i18n` 每种语言 3 个新键），不动元数据、契约和服务端；固定项沿用现有的每人固定数据（与桌面侧栏「收藏」同一份），不改存储形状。768 px 及以上完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/PhoneAppNavBar.tsx` 的 `phoneNavBarEntries`（固定项优先、补齐、跨应用的固定不占格）；② `ConsoleLayout.tsx` 的 `hidesPhoneNavBar` 与内容区底部留白；③ `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` 里手机抽屉新增的搜索框与星标（`phoneMenu`）。
- 两分钟验证：在仓根执行 `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/UnifiedSidebar.phoneNavBar-34594.test.tsx`，预期 11 个测试全部通过（375 宽下底部 4 格 +「更多」、星标后底部出现该项）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The bar** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/PhoneAppNavBar.tsx`, new): a fixed `nav` along the bottom edge, `h-12` plus the safe-area inset, up to four entry cells and a **More** cell.

- `phoneNavBarEntries(items, pinnedIds, guards, hasAddress)` picks the cells: the pinned ids (`useNavPins().pinnedIds`, the user's order) that this app's menu draws, then the app's drawn entries in menu order, to four. A pinned id the app's menu does not draw (another app's pin, or an entry the member cannot see) takes no cell, which is how pins are read per app without changing their stored shape (they are keyed by navigation id and are not app-scoped). `action` entries and entries with no address are left out (a cell opens a page).
- A cell opens what its drawer row opens (`resolveHref`) and lights when that row lights (`resolveActiveNavItem`, over the whole tree, so at most one cell lights). Label and icon are the row's (`resolveNavItemLabel`, `resolveNavItemIcon` with the same resolvers).
- **More** opens the drawer (`setOpenMobile(true)`); `aria-expanded` follows it.

**The full menu** (`UnifiedSidebar.tsx`): the existing phone drawer gains, only where the layout asks for the bar (`phoneNavBar` prop), a search box (the renderer's own `searchQuery`, cleared when the drawer closes) and a hint line, and every entry carries a star (`PhoneMenuStar` through `renderItemAction`) that calls the same `togglePin` the desktop ⋯ menu calls. The drawer's groups, area switcher and gates are unchanged. The bar reads every visible area of the app, from the same pruned trees the drawer draws (Studio: the rewritten tree the drawer shows).

**The route decision** (`ConsoleLayout.tsx`): `phoneNavBar = phone && !hidesPhoneNavBar(pathname)`, where `hidesPhoneNavBar` names the record page (`isRecordPagePath`), `/apps/APP/OBJECT/new` and `.../record/ID/edit`. While the bar is drawn, the inset gets `!pb-[calc(3rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]`: a self-bounded page (the list) ends above the bar, and a taller page scrolls its last row out from under it.

**The top-left control** (`AppHeader.tsx`): on a phone inside an app the slot holds a 44 px 「Back to home」 link to `useHomePath()` (the declared landing) instead of the sidebar trigger. From 768 px up the trigger is unchanged. This narrows the objectui#12429 "trigger at every width" layout below 768 px, per this card's item 3 (maintainer direction on epic #34571, epic comment 6936311101).

**The shared walk** (`@object-ui/layout`, surface widened by the seat): new export `drawnNavigationEntries(items, options)` in `NavigationRenderer.tsx`, the entries a tree draws in the sidebar's reading order (each level sorted by the internal `byNavOrder`, each node through `hasVisibleNavigationItems`). `AppSchemaRenderer`'s private `MobileBottomNav` now calls it instead of its own copy of the walk, with no change in output; `navOrder.ts`'s header names the new site (comment only). The console's bar calls the same helper, so neither tab bar writes the sort or the guard again.

**i18n**: `console.nav.phoneBarLabel`, `console.nav.searchMenu`, `console.nav.phoneBarHint` in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated with `scripts/gen-zh-hant.mjs`). The star reuses `console.nav.pinItem` / `unpinItem`; the back link reuses `layout.appSwitcher.backToHome`; More reuses `common.more`.

No new metadata key, no spec change, no server change.

## Tests

- `UnifiedSidebar.phoneNavBar-34594.test.tsx` (new; harness of `UnifiedSidebar.phoneDrawerCloses-29075` with a stateful pin store; real `@object-ui/layout` and `@object-ui/components`, 375 × 812): four entries + More with nothing pinned; pins first in pinned order then fill; a foreign pin and a hidden entry take no cell; the lit cell; More opens the drawer with search, six stars (the hidden entry has none) and search narrowing; a star pins through the store and the bar shows it first; controls: no bar without the layout's say-so, none at 768 px. Plus `phoneNavBarEntries` units: `order` honoured, cap at four with a duplicated pin, `action` and address-less entries left out.
- `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483.test.tsx` (new top-level describe in the existing harness): at 375 px the app root, list, view, dashboard and page ask for the bar and the inset keeps it free; record page, named record page, edit form and create form do not; at 768 / 1440 px no route does; `hidesPhoneNavBar` positives and negatives.
- `AppHeader.sidebarTrigger-12429.test.tsx` (new top-level describe, header prose updated): at 375 px the back link (accessible name, `/home`, `size-11`, first in the slot) and no trigger; at 768 px the trigger and no link; Home draws neither.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): replacing the pinned-ids loop with an empty list turned 4 of the 11 new sidebar tests red ("pinned entries come first…", "a pin this app's menu does not draw…", "a star in the full menu…", "caps at four…"); restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Fill reading.** The card says "the user's pinned entries, else the first four menu entries". With one to three pins the bar shows those pins first and fills the remaining cells from the menu, so the bar never shrinks to one cell after a first star; acceptance 2 (star an entry, it appears in the bar) holds either way. Say so if the bar should show pins only once any exist.
- **Pins are not per app in storage.** Two apps whose menus share a navigation id share that pin, as the desktop sidebar's Favorites already do; not changed here (the order forbids changing the stored shape).
- **FABs.** The list's create FAB sits at `bottom-36` (144 px), above the 48 px bar plus a 34 px safe area, so it needed no change (and `ObjectView.tsx` is outside this card's surface). The assistant FAB sits at `bottom-20` (80 px) on a phone; on a device with a 34 px home-indicator inset the bar's top edge is at 82 px, a 2 px overlap of the FAB's lower edge, drawn over by the FAB (z-50 over z-40). Noted, not changed.
- **Neighbours.** #34595 (record page bottom bar) is untouched: the bar is not mounted on record routes. #34596 (phone home FAB) is on Home, which is not an app route, so the bar is not drawn there.
- A group authored `expanded: false` keeps that initial state while searching the full menu (the renderer's search filters, it does not open groups); matches the desktop search behaviour.

## Verification

- Local, at head `0db6e109`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/layout/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/layout/` → 292 files / 3258 tests, one red first (`zh-hant-generated`: zh-Hant must be generated; regenerated with `gen-zh-hant.mjs`), then the failed file and the new file re-run green (21/21). The three touched test files: 3 files, 28 tests, green.
- Type-check (`pnpm run type-check`, both tsconfigs) of `@object-ui/layout`, `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`: exit 0.
- eslint on every changed file: 0 errors (warnings are the files' existing classes plus one `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the new file's exported helper, the same class `ConsoleLayout.tsx`'s `isRecordPagePath` carries).
- `ui` `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 40): results in the os-dev-report comment on #34594; every CI family is read from this PR's check-runs.
- Browser reading at 375 × 812 against a live boot: in the os-dev-report comment on #34594.
